independence_evidence: The about page describes Vanish Media as the publisher of Vanish Magazine within a small founder-run platform (masthead lists a founder, co-founders and a handful of staff), with no parent media group (https://vanish.today/about-us/).
qualifies_reason: Independent US outdoor-culture title with print issues 0, 1 and 3 all published in 2026, the latest in stock at retailers.
what_it_is: Vanish is a print magazine about the overlap of outdoor life and urban style: technical apparel and gear, design, architecture, travel and the brands and people shaping outdoor culture. Issues are themed paperbacks of around 200 pages with brand profiles, interviews and fashion-style photography; the third is titled 'The Outdoor Avant-Garde'. It is for readers interested in gorpcore fashion, outdoor design and adventure travel.

cover_candidates.notes: Front cover of issue 3 placed on the retailer's patterned 'Hello my name is' background; square file, cover roughly 700x900px. No cover image found on the publisher's own site.

uncertainties: The publisher's site has no shop, so no publisher cover price; retailer Le Grand Jeu lists issue 3 at EUR 24 (the printed cover carries GBP 20 / EUR 24 / USD 28). Issue 3's date is taken from the retailer listing published 6 July 2026 (year 2026 per its description); the publisher site still says 'Issue Zero out now'. City is based on the founder being 'currently living in New York' per the publisher's own interview and magCulture's 'New York' attribution; the LLC's registered location was not found.
